description: Cyclonic Storm Landfalls in Bangladesh, West Bengal and Odisha 1877-2016 is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Recurrent cyclonic storms in the Bay of Bengal inflict massive losses on the coastal regions of Bangladesh and India. Information on occurrences and severities of cyclones is necessary for understanding household and community responses to cyclone risks. Coverage: Bangladesh, India. It has 8 files in PDF, XLS. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
